svg.title: Active/active vs active/passive
svg.desc: Left, active/passive: site A takes all traffic while site B sits idle. When A fails, users see errors until B is woken up and promoted. Right, active/active: both sites serve half the traffic, and when A fails the load balancer simply sends everyone to B with no gap.
svg.text: Site A fails. Passive needs a failover first, active just reroutes.
